name: Pieceful Gallery
detailed_description:
In real life, there are many jigsaw enthusiasts who, for various reasons, can’t complete a puzzle. Pieceful Gallery is a game that fully simulates the classic jigsaw experience: use your mouse to organize and rotate puzzle pieces, then assemble the entire image in the traditional way. There’s no space limitation, progress is saved automatically, and levels range from easy to difficult. Come try it for free!

Game Features:
· Faithfully replicates the operation and challenge of a classic jigsaw—easy to learn and use
· Each level features a high-definition work of art, allowing you to appreciate masterpieces as you play
· Puzzle sizes increase from 100 to 1,000 pieces, suitable for beginners or seasoned players of any age
· Relaxing background music to soothe your mind while you play

(All art used in the game is in the public domain.)
